name: rs-corporate-tax
description: Serbian corporate income tax (porez na dobit pravnih lica) for tax year 2026 under the Zakon o porezu na dobit pravnih lica (ZPDPL). Covers resident companies and permanent establishments of foreign companies; the flat 15% rate; the tax balance from accounting profit to taxable profit (non-deductible items, expense caps, tax depreciation groups, capital gains); 5-year loss carry-forward; tax consolidation at 75%; thin capitalisation (4:1, 10:1 for banks and leasing) and transfer pricing; the PDP return 180 days after year end and monthly advances by the 15th; penalties and interest; 20% withholding on outbound dividends, interest and royalties (25% for preferential tax jurisdictions on some items) and treaty relief; and the 2026 amendments deferred to 2027, 2028 or EU accession. Trigger on: Serbia corporate tax, porez na dobit, PDP Serbia, DOO tax, Serbian withholding tax. Out of scope: individuals and entrepreneurs (serbia-income-tax), VAT (serbia-vat), payroll (serbia-payroll), socia
